title: The Quiet Bakery
author: Rosalind Ishikawa
blurb: Rosalind Pemberton, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
